name: Reduce stuck bead retry ceiling (corrected)
hypothesis: Beads like gromit-7esx (3 failures at stuck_bead_threshold=3) consume iterations without succeeding. Reducing stuck_bead_threshold from 3 to 2 will save 1 wasted iteration per stuck bead. The previous experiment incorrectly changed max_consecutive_skips (precheck loop guard) instead of stuck_bead_threshold.
change: Set stuck_bead_threshold to 2 in gromit.yaml (currently 3). This causes beads to be skipped after 2 cross-run failures instead of 3.
measurement: Compare total wasted iterations on stuck beads before vs after. Target: reduce from 3 failures per stuck bead to max 2. Track whether any beads that would have succeeded on attempt 3 are now skipped prematurely.
risk: Some beads may succeed on attempt 3 with model escalation (haiku->sonnet->opus). Reducing the threshold from 3 to 2 removes one retry opportunity. The escalation chain has 3 tiers, so threshold=2 means the highest tier (opus) never gets attempted for stuck beads.
